breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to replace the distributed load with its resultant applied at midspan. Instead, it explicitly states to use 'standard distributed load analysis using Euler-Bernoulli beam theory' and 'standard beam deflection formulas for uniformly distributed loads on cantilever beams,' which aligns with the ground truth prompt that simply asks for deflection and slope under the actual uniform distributed load without any resultant substitution.
